comment: Folders no Flockadoo engine loads, which are never downloaded, hashed, sized or judged. One list for getModels (SKIP_MANIFEST_DIRS), the client (pkg/verify skipManifestDirs) and the server judge (pkg/modelverify altWeightDirs). The original is flockadoo-server tests/contract/testdata/skip-dirs.json; change all three copies together.
